title: Complete Apple WWDC | Steve Jobs talk and answer developers questions | 1997
summary: The full 1997 WWDC session in which Steve Jobs, newly back at Apple, takes developer questions for about an hour. He discusses OpenDoc, Microsoft, clones, Newton, advertising and Apple's strategy.
why: HN readers recommend it as an unfiltered view of Jobs' strategic thinking and decisiveness, including the famous answer on why OpenDoc was killed.

quote.text: For those that haven't seen it the whole thing is worth it
